scope: First live AT dialogue with the MD over the AT/MUX byte pipe. The AP sends commands, the MD answers with its own AT stack.

link.handshake: first run: sabm=1 ua=1 (the MD answers a SABM with its own SABM, so both directions settle); later runs: sabm=0 ua=0 because the MD is already established and ignores a duplicate SABM
link.md_to_ap_before_sabm: raw AT text, not 0710 framed: e.g. +EIMSGEO: 100,1,"",... and +EWIFIRSSITHRCFG: 0,4,-85,-88,-75,-78
link.md_to_ap_after_sabm: the echo arrives 0710 framed (UIH), the AT answers arrive as raw text (+CSQ: 99, 99 / OK), so the client demultiplexes both shapes from one stream
link.queue: 5, matching both the vendor DATA_AT_CMD_Q table and the frames the MD actually sent

interpretation.channel: the AT transport works end to end: the AP writes 0710 UIH frames and the MD answers
interpretation.state: the modem reports minimum functionality (CFUN 0), no operator, no PS attach and no signal, and registration is denied (CREG stat 3)
interpretation.not_surprising: there is no SIM in the slot (AT+CPIN? ERROR), so denial is expected; the point of this run is that the transport and the MD AT stack are alive

pipe_counters_after_dialogue: open=0 hs2=1 error=0 queued=0 rx_frames=124 rx_bytes=665 rx_dropped=0 tx_frames=31 tx_bytes=330 tx_error=0
fixes_found_on_hardware: sysfs_emit() requires a page-aligned buffer, so appending the pipe line at an offset silently produced nothing; the status now uses scnprintf with an explicit size
the client assumed a framed MD-to-AP direction; it must demultiplex 0710 frames and raw AT text from the same stream
a late answer leaked into the next command, so each command now discards queued input before sending
not_claimed: any radio capability: no SIM, no attach, no data
that the MD's 0710 implementation matches the codec beyond this dialogue
